title: Write test vectors for article format, CID computation, and serialization
description:
Create a test vector suite with known-good inputs and expected outputs for: article canonical serialization, CID computation, and signature verification. Vectors must come from an external reference (kubo CLI, Python cryptography library, or published spec). Artifact: core/tests/vectors/ directory with vector files and a test binary that validates each one.

Acceptance:
- At least 3 article serialization vectors from an external reference
- At least 2 CID vectors cross-validated against kubo `ipfs block put`
- At least 2 signature vectors cross-validated against a Python or Go ed25519 implementation
- All vectors are offline (no network access in tests)
- `cargo test` runs all vectors and fails if any mismatch
